The PDL prints 'mirabegron tabs PA' (generic, non-preferred) and 'Myrbetriq susp PA QL' (non-preferred). The BOGL flag rests on the brand-preferred listing and an AB-rating assumption for the generic that the PDL does not state, so verification is partial. Gemtesa (vibegron) is non-preferred with PA. Strength and sig are standard label dosing. [Sonnet check 2026-11-02: PDL p.72 confirms Myrbetriq tabs Preferred QL only; mirabegron tabs Non-Preferred PA. Generic mirabegron ER tablets are AB-rated to Myrbetriq in the FDA Orange Book (Orange Book knowledge, not stated on the PDL; same 25/50 mg ER tablet), so the BOGL is same-form; verify the AB code at the point of prescribing. Kept partial.]
